name: Bombardier
verdict: The four Bombardier-family 'Principal Shareholders' hold 80.80% of Bombardier Inc.'s 10-vote Class A shares, 47.83% of all voting rights (the company's Shares & dividends page). Nothing found.
note: Sponsor of car #54 for 2026; the same release says Bombardier also sponsors driver Thomas Flohr's helmet, race suit and trackwear.
